about_the_game:
About the Game
Embark on a magical journey through the enchanting world of Moominvalley! Travel with Moomintroll, Snufkin, and friends across forests, misty mountains, open seas, and lonely lighthouses. Along the way, you’ll help friends, solve playful challenges, and uncover the wonders of this beloved Nordic world filled with charm, humor, and friendship.

Blending a bird’s-eye perspective with the immersive depth of VR, the game offers a unique way to explore. You’ll climb, row, swim, and interact with the world while always feeling part of something larger, cinematic, and magical.

Gameplay & Features

VR-Optimized Controls & Perspective

  • Unlike most VR titles, this game blends a bird’s-eye perspective with the immersive depth of virtual reality. Players can freely look around, enjoy the world’s cinematic scale, and still interact up close with characters and objects through intuitive VR controls. Simple actions like grabbing, climbing, rowing, or carrying feel natural — but combined with the elevated perspective, it creates a truly unique way to experience Moominvalley that’s both comfortable and magical.

• Playful Exploration – Climb, row, swim, and traverse across handcrafted environments inspired by the iconic Moominvalley TV series.

• Companion Adventures – Travel with beloved characters like Moomintroll and Snufkin. Each has unique skills that help solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and overcome obstacles.

• Interactive Puzzles – Every challenge is designed to be fun, lighthearted, and family-friendly.

• Atmospheric Environments

• Length & Replay – The main story offers about 2 hours of adventure, with secrets and alternative paths to discover.

Why It’s Unique

This is the first-ever official Moomin VR game, combining timeless Nordic storytelling with modern immersive gameplay. Whether you’re a long-time fan or completely new to Moominvalley, this adventure captures the warmth, humor, and friendship that make the Moomins beloved worldwide.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Core i5-7500 / Ryzen 5 1600
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / GTX 1060 (6GB) or AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 6 MB available space
  • VR Support: All PCVR Headsets
  • Additional Notes: VR Headset required!

short_description: Journey through forests, misty mountains, open seas, and a storm-swept islands with its lighthousse in this magical VR adventure. Explore with Moomintroll, Snufkin, and friends, solving playful puzzles and uncovering moments of humor, warmth, and Nordic wonder.
